title: docs(AGENTS.md): add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY requirement and vitest hang caveat
body: ## Summary Updates `AGENTS.md` with two important caveats discovered during Cloud VM environment setup: 1. **STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is required to start the dev server** — The Stripe SDK is initialized at module level in `server/routers/dashboardRouter.ts` and crashes the process if no API key is provided. A placeholder value works fine for local development. 2. **vitest never exits cleanly in Cloud VMs** — Several test files import OAuth/Stripe modules that hold open handles, causing the vitest process to hang indefinitely after all tests complete. Using `timeout 120 pnpm exec vitest run` is the workaround. ## Changes - Updated "Running the dev server" section to include `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` - Updated environment variables caveat to mention Stripe requirement - Updated test behavior caveat with Cloud VM-specific hanging behavior and workaround ## Evidence [ultrasoundassist_ui_navigation_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-16f39745-f34f-450b-b49a-c48e2ea513e2/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fultrasoundassist_ui_navigation_demo.mp4) Production build UI rendering correctly with navigation working end-to-end. To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
